report: Many Tech Experts Say Digital Disruption Will Hurt Democracy
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Technology weakens democracy by 2030
entries.quote: Between now and 2030, how will use of technology by citizens, civil society groups and governments affect core aspects of democracy and democratic representation? Will they mostly weaken core aspects of democracy and democratic representation, mostly strengthen core aspects [...] or not much change in core aspects of democracy and democratic representation?
entries.subject: technology and democracy
entries.answer_mapping: agree = mostly weaken democracy; disagree = mostly strengthen democracy

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
